More.title: More
More.lead: Your profile, the app’s language, and signing out.

Profile.title: Profile
Profile.lead: Your name and phone, whether neighbours see them in the directory, and the app’s language.
Profile.committeeLead: Neighbours see this contact on the Committee page, for your role. It is separate from whether the directory shows your own phone and email.

ProfileForm.name: Name
ProfileForm.phoneHint: Optional. An Israeli number, such as 050‑123‑4567.
ProfileForm.emailHint: You sign in with this address, so it can’t be changed here.
ProfileForm.welcomeLead: You’ve joined the building. Add your name, so neighbours and the committee know who you are.
ProfileForm.welcomeDoneTitle: Thanks, neighbours will see your name.

CommitteeContactForm.hint: Optional. Leave both empty to publish no contact.

ContactVisibility.label: Show my phone and email to neighbours
ContactVisibility.hint: When this is off, neighbours see only your name and apartment.

Demo.readOnly: This is a demo building, so changes are turned off.

Admin.title: Admin
Admin.lead: The committee’s tools for running the building: its details and money, its apartments and the people in them. What you see here depends on your role.
Admin.buildingLinkBody: Name, address, quorum and billing, and corrections to the fund.
Admin.apartmentsLinkBody: Add, edit and remove apartments, and set when each starts paying.
Admin.peopleLinkBody: Roles, committee titles, and who lives in the building.
Admin.feesLinkBody: The monthly fee, and the apartments that pay a different one.
Admin.paymentsLinkBody: Every apartment’s months: record payments and void wrong ones.
Admin.expensesLinkBody: What the building spends, with receipts: add expenses and void wrong ones.

AdminBuilding.title: Building details
AdminBuilding.lead: The building’s name and address, the month billing starts from, and the quorum for the annual meeting. The fund shows its opening balance and every correction to it.
AdminBuilding.openingBalanceHint: Set when the building was created. To correct the fund, add an adjustment.
AdminBuilding.emptyBody: If the fund doesn’t match the bank, record the difference here with a reason.

BuildingForm.name: Building name
BuildingForm.quorumHint: The share of apartments that must take part, in percent.
BuildingForm.billingStartHint: Apartments owe the monthly fee from this month on, unless they have their own start. Without a month picker, type it as YYYY-MM, for example 2026-01.
BuildingForm.confirmBody: Billing would start in {to} instead of {from}. This changes what every apartment owes, past months included.

BuildingErrors.name: Enter a name of 2 to 80 characters.
BuildingErrors.quorumPercent: Enter a whole number from 1 to 100.
BuildingErrors.saveFailed: We couldn’t save the details. Please try again.

AdjustmentForm.title: Add an adjustment
AdjustmentForm.description: Corrects the building fund. It’s recorded with your name and today’s date.
AdjustmentForm.reasonHint: For example: bank fees not recorded earlier.

AdjustmentErrors.direction: Choose whether the money is added to the fund or taken from it.
AdjustmentErrors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, such as 250 or 1,200.50.
AdjustmentErrors.reason: Write a reason of 3 to 200 characters.
AdjustmentErrors.addFailed: We couldn’t add the adjustment. Please try again.

AdminFees.title: Fees
AdminFees.lead: The monthly fee every apartment pays, and the apartments that pay a different one. A new fee starts from the month you choose; the months before it keep the fee they had.
AdminFees.noFeeBody: Set the monthly fee every apartment pays. Until then, no one owes anything.
AdminFees.apartmentsLead: Apartments that pay a different fee from the building's, such as penthouses. Their own fee applies even when the building's changes.
AdminFees.noOverridesTitle: Every apartment pays the building's fee
AdminFees.noOverridesBody: If an apartment pays a different amount, such as a penthouse, set its own fee here.
AdminFees.noApartmentsBody: Once the building's apartments are added, you can set an apartment's own fee here.
AdminFees.followedRange: Followed the building fee from {from} to {until}

ApartmentFee.title: Monthly fee
ApartmentFee.none: No fee applies yet: the building has no fee for this month.
ApartmentFee.upcomingBuilding: The building's fee changes to {amount} from {month}.
ApartmentFee.noOwnFees: It pays the building's fee. If it pays a different amount, set a fee of its own.

FeeForm.buildingDescription: Every apartment without a fee of its own pays it from the month you choose. Earlier months keep their fee.
FeeForm.apartmentDescription: The apartment pays it from the month you choose, instead of the building's fee. Earlier months keep their fee.
FeeForm.effectiveFromHint: A fee already set from that month is replaced.

FollowBuilding.title: Apartment {number} pays the building fee from {month}?
FollowBuilding.body: Its own fee ends: from {month} it pays the building's fee, and any later change to it. Earlier months keep the fee they had.
FollowBuilding.done: Apartment {number} pays the building fee from {month}

FeeErrors.amount: Enter a monthly fee above zero, such as 350 or 412.50.

FeeErrors.beforeBillingStart: Choose {month} or later: billing starts then.

FeeErrors.tooFarAhead: Choose {month} or earlier: a fee is set at most a year ahead.
FeeErrors.beforeOwnFee: Choose {month} or later: its own fee starts then.

FeeErrors.notFound: That apartment isn't in the building anymore.

ApartmentPayments.title: Payments
ApartmentPayments.empty: No payments recorded yet. Record one when the apartment pays.

PaymentForm.title: Payment for apartment {number}
PaymentForm.description: One payment can cover several months: it's split from the oldest month on, and never more than they owe.
PaymentForm.monthsHint: Choosing months fills in what they owe.
PaymentForm.nothingOpen: Nothing is left to pay, up to and including {month}.
PaymentForm.recorded: Recorded {amount} for apartment {number} ({count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}})

VoidPayment.title: Void the payment for {month}?
VoidPayment.body: {amount} stops counting, and {month} is owed again. The payment stays listed as voided; it can't be edited.
VoidPayment.reasonHint: The apartment’s residents see this reason. For example: recorded twice by mistake.

PaymentErrors.paidOn: Enter the date it was paid.
PaymentErrors.paidOnFuture: Choose today or an earlier date.
PaymentErrors.paidOnTooEarly: Choose a date from {month} on: a payment is dated at most a year before billing starts.
PaymentErrors.tooMuch: That's more than these months owe: {amount} at most.
PaymentErrors.tooLittle: That doesn't reach {month}: enter more, or leave that month out.
PaymentErrors.notBilled: Billing starts in {month}: choose that month or a later one.
PaymentErrors.tooFarAhead: Choose {month} or earlier: a payment goes at most a year ahead.

PaymentErrors.saveFailed: We couldn't record the payment. Please try again.
PaymentErrors.paymentNotFound: That payment isn't in the building's records.
PaymentErrors.voidFailed: We couldn't void the payment. Please try again.

AdminExpenses.title: Expenses
AdminExpenses.lead: What the building spends its money on, each with its receipt. Every expense comes off the building fund; a wrong one is voided, never edited.
AdminExpenses.emptyBody: Add the first one above: what it was for, how much and when, with its receipt.

ExpenseForm.receiptHint: A photo or scan: JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF, up to 4 MB.
ExpenseForm.receiptAgain: Choose {name} again: a file isn’t kept after an error.
ExpenseForm.receiptTooLarge: That file is over 4 MB. Choose a smaller photo or scan.

ExpenseErrors.spentOn: Enter the date it was spent.
ExpenseErrors.spentOnFuture: Choose today or an earlier date.
ExpenseErrors.spentOnTooEarly: Choose {date} or later: spending before billing starts is part of the opening balance.
ExpenseErrors.description: Say what it was for, in 2 to 200 characters.
ExpenseErrors.receiptEmpty: That file is empty. Choose the receipt again.
ExpenseErrors.receiptTooLarge: That file is over 4 MB. Choose a smaller photo or scan.
ExpenseErrors.receiptType: That file isn’t a JPEG, PNG, WebP or PDF. Choose a photo or a PDF of the receipt.
ExpenseErrors.saveFailed: We couldn’t add the expense. Please try again.
ExpenseErrors.notFound: That expense isn’t in the building’s records.
ExpenseErrors.voidFailed: We couldn’t void the expense. Please try again.

VoidExpense.title: Void the expense “{description}”?
VoidExpense.body: {amount} goes back into the building fund. The expense stays listed as voided, with its receipt; it can’t be edited.
VoidExpense.reasonHint: For example: recorded twice by mistake.

AdminPayments.title: Payments
AdminPayments.lead: Every apartment’s months at a glance: who’s behind, and each apartment’s payments to record or void.

AdminPayments.upToDateBody: No apartment owes for an earlier month.

ApartmentForm.addDescription: Its residents join later, with an invite link.

ApartmentForm.billingStartHint: Leave it empty to use the building’s month.
ApartmentForm.confirmTitle: Change when this apartment’s billing starts?

ApartmentRemove.title: Remove apartment {number}?
ApartmentRemove.description: No one lives in it and it has no payments, so nothing else changes. This can’t be undone.

InviteAdmin.title: Invite
InviteAdmin.lead: One link for this apartment: up to 6 people can join with it within 14 days.
InviteAdmin.none: No active invite. Create one and send the link to the people who live here.
InviteAdmin.onceNote: For safety, a link is shown only once, right after it’s created. To send it again, create a new invite; the current one then stops working.

InviteAdminClient.replaceBody: The current link stops working, also for anyone who hasn’t used it yet. People who already joined stay.
InviteAdminClient.revokeBody: The link stops working at once. People who already joined stay.
InviteAdminClient.newLead: Copy it now: it won’t be shown again.

InviteAll.dialogBody: {active, plural, one {One apartment already has} other {# apartments already have}} an active invite, whose link was shown only when it was created.
InviteAll.missingOnly: {count, plural, one {Only the one without an invite} other {Only the # without an invite}}
InviteAll.replaceAll: {count, plural, one {Replace it too} other {Replace all # invites}}
InviteAll.replaceNote: Replacing makes the current links stop working.
InviteAll.resultTitle: {count, plural, one {One new invite link} other {# new invite links}}
InviteAll.resultLead: Copy them now: they’re shown only this once. Each link lets up to 6 people join within 14 days.
InviteAll.skipped: {count, plural, one {One apartment already had an active invite and isn’t listed.} other {# apartments already had an active invite and aren’t listed.}}
InviteAll.sectionLead: Create a link for each apartment and send it to the people who live there, for example in the building’s WhatsApp group.

CopyButton.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy automatically. The text is selected: copy it with your device’s copy command.

JoinInvite.signInLead: Sign in first; you’ll come back here to join.

People.name: Name
People.emptyBody: People join with an invite to their apartment. Create the invites on the apartments page.

PersonRole.title: Role of {name}
PersonRole.description: Committee members and admins open the admin section. Only admins manage the building and its people.
PersonRole.residentHint: Sees the building and their own payments.
PersonRole.adminHint: Also manages the building, its apartments and its people.
PersonRole.committeeTitleHint: Optional, up to 40 characters, such as Chair or Treasurer.
PersonRole.selfDemoteWarning: You will lose the admin pages and go to Home as soon as you save.

PersonRemove.title: Remove {name} from the building?
PersonRemove.description: This removes {name} from all their apartments and from the building, and they lose access to it at once. Their account remains: a new invite brings them back.
PersonRemove.selfDescription: This removes you from all your apartments and from the building. You will lose access to this building at once. Your account remains: a new invite brings you back.
